primary: The pooled evidential-frame rate (EV-POOLED) in first-person claimed-voice span interiors over the own-voice rate, within creator, as a log ratio on the larger voice-eligible set.
margin: Margin log 0.223 (0.80 to 1.25). No direction is named (the accounts disagree); reading words for a row with no named direction.
tier: L (lists hashed), by-voice on the larger voice-eligible set under section 2.2; the voice-free family prevalence rows on the 48 as a second description on a disjoint set, the 23 as the published reference, the 71 described only.
decidability: Expected to stay undetermined unless the eligible set reaches about 40 and the difference is large.

primary: Each rerun entry's registered primary, read unchanged on the 48, with the 23 as the published reference and the 71 described, one per entry, in the margin or band that entry registered (or deposit 2's by type).
tier: label-free list counts on the 48 as the primary row, a second description on a disjoint set; the 23 as the published reference; the 71 described only.
decidability: Many lexicon rows will stay undetermined; classes that stay thin on the 48 read "not computed", and "thin on a second, disjoint set" is then the description.

primary: The milieu difference in differences: cross-creator, topic-matched distance, claimed-claimed minus own-own, for the same creator pairs, in the content TF-IDF representation.
tier: unsplit on all eligible seen creators, as r3-P15 ran, the vocabulary fitted by fold; by-voice sets pass section 5.
decidability: "Creator over name" is close to built in and is never the reading; the difference in differences may decide only if 30 or more creators qualify; the name rungs are expected to stay undetermined or not computed.

primary: The within-creator log ratio of mention rates, class-1 years over family A, per 100,000 tokens, from rule-found year tokens only.
margin: Margin 0.80 to 1.25. No direction is named.
tier: the primary and every row built only from rule-found year tokens and deposit 4's rule-defined classes is a label-free count: L on the 48 as a second description on a disjoint set, the 23 as the published reference (r3-P40's timeline), the 71 described only.
decidability: Expected to stay undetermined; the entry stops at salience if the cue families stay thin.

primary: The recovery slope of each candidate on the validation creators, read against the pass band 0.9 to 1.1 under both stretch algorithms (decision 129.13).
tier: instrument development on the 48 only; no non-development value is read before a new deposit hashes the frozen instrument, its battery table and its caps.
decidability: Pass or fail; "no candidate passes" is a stated possible outcome, and rate rows then stay capped.

primary: The sustained entry shift in articulation rate, as a log ratio against matched edges, under the revised instrument if f4-Q05a passes and is deposited, otherwise under the deposited deflated-margin rule (no B reachable; A only beyond the slope's bound times the margin).
margin: Margin log 0.223. No direction is named.
tier: X+T on all gated eligible seen creators (fold seed 2026112761), every data-tuned part cross-fitted, the fold-to-fold disagreement printed as an instrument value.
decidability: Unless f4-Q05a passes and the gated count falls where a method holds, the primary is expected to stay undetermined; "not measurable acoustically in this corpus" is a possible second outcome.

primary: The claimed-over-own log balance of inner over outer authority directives, log((INNER-DIR + 0.5) / (OUTER-DIR + 0.5)), within creator, on the larger voice-eligible set.
margin: Margin log 0.223. No direction is named.
tier: L; by-voice rows on the larger voice-eligible set; voice-free prevalence on the 48 as a second description on a disjoint set, the 23 as the published reference, the 71 described only.
decidability: Expected to stay undetermined unless the balance is large; several families may read "not computed".

primary: Row 0: r4-P23's registered within-creator difference in bounded share, contact class minus world event, on the larger eligible set (every seen creator with 5 or more ledger statements in each class).
margin: 5 percentage points (deposit 2). Named direction: negative (contact statements bounded less often).
tier: L (the frozen rule coder) over model-coded candidates, with the tuning-exposure note and the private guard.
decidability: Plainly: the primary is expected to stay undetermined; the entry's value is a frozen, dated description of what could ever be scored as worded.

primary: The within-creator claimed-over-own ratio of the balance index's odds (TECHNO against LINEAGE), on the larger voice-eligible set.
margin: Margin 0.80 to 1.25. No direction is named.
tier: L; by-voice rows on the larger voice-eligible set; voice-free prevalence on the 48 as a second description on a disjoint set, the 23 as the published reference, the 71 described only.
decidability: Expected to stay undetermined; the residual pair and the repertoires are likely to read "not computed" on the 48, which is itself the description.

primary: The proxy's agreement contrast: word-weighted kappa on claimed, own and other of the proxy against the small model of record, minus that of the middle model against the small model, on the larger set's middle-subset units, cross-fitted.
tier: (i) to (v) are acts with no tier; (vi) is X+T on the larger set.
decidability: The primary may stay undetermined; the entry's main value is the ledger and the gate.

primary: The claimed-over-own ratio of decode-disagreement rates in WC-EVHEDGE, record against the larger-model re-decode, within creator, on the complement set.
margin: Margin 0.80 to 1.25. No direction is named.
tier: unsplit on all seen creators; by-voice rows under section 5.
decidability: Expected to stay undetermined or to read A only for a large difference; a clean result under a same-family decode never clears shared normalisation.

primary: The composition test across the generation families on the 48, voice-free, read against r3-P43's deposited placebo and pseudo-stratum bands: A outside both bands; B inside both; otherwise undetermined; the 23 as the published reference.
tier: voice-free rows on the 48 as a second description on a disjoint set, the 23 as the published reference, the 71 described only; by-voice rows under section 5 and the private guard.
decidability: The composition and voice rows are expected to stay undetermined unless the structure is strong.

primary: Where the platform frame sits in the session's order: the creator-balanced share of platform-frame time lying between the first and the last claimed-voice unit, observed minus its within-recording permutation expectation, in claimed-voice recordings, read against the same quantity in the own-voice-talk reference cut by the same rules (a difference in differences).
margin: Margin 5 points. No direction is named.
tier: fixed rules with no data-tuned part for (a) and (b), one description on all eligible creators; lists for (c) to (e) are tier L; by-voice rows under section 5 and the private guard; voice-free list counts on the 48 as a second description on a disjoint set.
decidability: The order description will print; the primary may decide only if 40 or so creators qualify; most address, genre and fear rows are rare-count rows and are expected to stay undetermined.

primary: The printed count of "persists" among the rows that carry a reading, against the central 90% of the joint stationarity envelope at k = 3 (k = 4 the second run).
decidability: This entry says what the round could ever have shown, and expects to show that exposure decided most of its readings.

primary: The return column on the January 2027 group at the 12-week horizon: within creator, over the creator's distinct anchors, the share returned to minus the placebo share.
margin: A risk difference of 5 percentage points. No direction is named: the accounts disagree, and their directions sit in the account table (section 4.8).
tier: L: the anchor rule, the placebo rule, L15 and PT's rule are fixed before any later upload exists, over the frozen ledger's model-coded candidates, on every seen creator who holds a group statement.
decidability: Plainly: the primary is expected to stay undetermined or not computed; the entry's value is a registration made before any of these windows closed, with each account's forbidden cells fixed in advance.
